modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mythicloo: Hostile mobs you kill can drop weapons, bows and armor with random rarity and affixes: more damage, life steal, true-aim arrows, more health… The higher the mob's level, the better. Designed to be played with Bloodmoon & Bosses and Hero's Forge. Server-side: vanilla clients can join.
